summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The State Street SPDR Portfolio MSCI Global Stock Market ETF (SPGM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI AC World IMI index, a market-cap-weighted index of global stocks covering 99% of the developed and emerging markets capitalization. SPGM was launched on Feb 27, 2012 and is issued by State Street.

holdings.infoBox: SPGM is an equity ETF with a total of 2932 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 4.37%, Apple at 4.08%, Alphabet at 3.08%, Microsoft at 3.05%, and Amazon.com at 2.02%.
